title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Acts 9: Saul on the road to Damascus, Ananias sent to him, and Peter at Lydda and Joppa.

questions.text: What did Saul ask the high priest for?
questions.explanation: He asked for letters to the synagogues of Damascus, so that he might bring any of the Way bound to Jerusalem.

answers.text: Letters to the synagogues of Damascus
Soldiers to go with him to Damascus
Money for the journey to Damascus
A place in the council at Jerusalem

questions.text: What did the voice say when a light from the sky shone around him?
questions.explanation: He fell on the earth and heard a voice saying, "Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?"

answers.text: "Why do you stand looking into the sky?"
"Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?"

questions.text: How did the Lord answer when Saul asked who he was?
questions.explanation: The Lord said, "I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting."

answers.text: "I am an angel of the Lord."
"I am the God of your fathers."
"I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting."

questions.text: How long was Saul without sight after this?
questions.explanation: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

questions.text: What was the name of the street where Ananias was sent?
questions.explanation: The Lord told Ananias to go to the street which is called Straight and inquire in the house of Judah for Saul.

questions.text: What did the Lord say Saul was to him?
questions.explanation: The Lord said Saul was his chosen vessel to bear his name before the nations and kings and the children of Israel.

answers.text: His chosen vessel to bear his name
A servant of the chief priests

questions.text: What fell from Saul's eyes when Ananias laid hands on him?
questions.explanation: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes and he received his sight, then he arose and was baptized.

questions.text: How did his disciples get Saul out of Damascus when the Jews watched the gates?
questions.explanation: His disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

answers.text: They hid him in the synagogue
They sent him out with Barnabas
They lowered him through the wall in a basket
They led him out at daybreak

questions.text: Whom did Peter heal at Lydda?
questions.explanation: At Lydda he found Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed, and he arose immediately.

questions.text: What did Peter say to the woman at Joppa after he had prayed?
questions.explanation: Turning to the body, he said, "Tabitha, get up!" and she opened her eyes and sat up.
